David and I once again drag all our stuff to train platform. Another weekend is almost over. I'm at the Fullerton station on Monday morning waiting for the Red Line train when I notice a guy on the platform that I have seen a few times before. He looks over at me and smiles. Maybe he has noticed me, too, during the last few weeks? He is really cute. As the train pulls into the station, I make sure to get into the same car as him. Once on the train, we are standing close together. Since the train is so crowded, we can’t say anything to each other. He gets off at the Grand stop, which is one stop before mine. As I watch him get lost in the crowd, I wonder when I will see him again. Over the next few days, he is on the train platform standing in the exact same spot. I’m pretty sure he is doing this on purpose.
